paper: Secret Collusion among AI Agents: Multi-Agent Deception via Steganography
collusion_operationalized_as: steganographic encoding concealed from an overseer
method_or_mitigation: mitigations evaluated (monitoring, paraphrasing, parameter optimization) - all found limited
notes: Motwani, Baranchuk, Strohmeier, Bolina, Torr, Hammond, Schroeder de Witt. Establishes the subfield.

paper: Colosseum: Auditing Collusion in Cooperative Multi-Agent Systems
environments: Hospital patient routing; Jira ticket allocation; meeting scheduling - all DCOP
channel_provenance: GRANTED - verbatim: instantiates secret communication channels between agents as a controlled auditing intervention
collusion_operationalized_as: Delta-collusion: coalition S produces an assignment deviating >= Delta from the cooperative optimum; regret vs cooperative optimum
detection_signal: BOTH required: action-based (coalition-advantage regret) AND communication-based (GPT-5.4 LLM-judge, 0-5 Likert)
agents_and_topology: 2-agent coalitions up to network-wide; complete, path, star, Barabasi-Albert, Watts-Strogatz, Erdos-Renyi
method_or_mitigation: 3 mitigations: audit private channels; stricter access control on high-leverage agents; verify claims against shared state
notes: Nakamura, Kumar, Das, Abdelnabi, Mahmud, Fioretto, Zilberstein, Bagdasarian. Taxonomy: emergent / direct / attempted. Limitation (verbatim): homogeneous teams with shared model backbone; heterogeneous deployments with varied models, prompts, permissions, and tool access left to future work.

environments: pricing duopoly; first-price auction (3 bidders); peer review (3 agents over submission pools)
channel_provenance: GRANTED (public channel; steganography hidden inside it)

paper: NARCBench (Detecting Multi-Agent Collusion Through Multi-Agent Interpretability)
environments: three tiers: Core, Transfer, Stego (blackjack card-counting)
collusion_operationalized_as: multi-agent deception; per-agent deception score aggregated to group level
detection_signal: WHITE-BOX linear probes on model activations. 1.00 AUROC in-distribution; 0.60-0.86 zero-shot transfer; 0.99-1.00 on stego where an LLM judge on table-talk FAILS
agents_and_topology: multi-agent scenarios; 4 open-weight models (Qwen3-32B / Llama-3.1-70B / DeepSeek-R1 32B / GPT-OSS-20B); 6 probe architectures
notes: Requires open weights - inapplicable to a closed third-party app.

paper: TAMAS: Benchmarking Adversarial Risks in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
environments: 5 scenarios; 300 adversarial instances; 211 tools; 100 harmless tasks
collusion_operationalized_as: colluding agents as one of 6 attack types
detection_signal: Effective Robustness Score (ERS): safety vs task-effectiveness tradeoff
agents_and_topology: 10 backbone LLMs; 3 interaction configurations from Autogen and CrewAI

paper: Voluntary Collusion with Secret Tools in Competing LLM Agents
environments: Liar's Bar (competitive deception); Cleanup (mixed-motive resource management)
channel_provenance: GRANTED - the secret tool is handed to the agent as an option
collusion_operationalized_as: adoption rate of an explicitly-unfair tool
agents_and_topology: 12 models at 3 scales (7B / 70B / proprietary) x 6 prompt variants
method_or_mitigation: explicit ethical framing reduces adoption; unfairness labels and baseline alignment insufficient
notes: Zeng, Rudzicz. Headline: safety-aligned agents voluntarily collude when it confers advantage.

paper: Tool Use Enables Undetectable Steganography in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
channel_provenance: PARTIALLY FOUND - agents implement stegosystems themselves; recover implementation details via web search; hide covert-channel logic inside existing multi-agent codebases
notes: HIGHEST THREAT. Names the remaining barrier as coordination: whether independent agents converge on compatible schemes and parameters, treating stego design choices as FOCAL POINTS. Risk most acute with shared artefacts, repeated interaction, tool-mediated search. MUST READ IN FULL.

paper: Steganalysis of Adaptive Covert Collusion in Tool-Using Agent Populations: A Black-Box, Cross-Principal Approach
detection_signal: BLACK-BOX: messages, tool calls, and TIMING only - no weights or activations
notes: Timing is already treated as an observable. Do not stake the OS-signal contribution on timing alone.

collusion_operationalized_as: each message individually truthful and benign; the SEQUENCE encodes the coordination signal
notes: Important corrective: covert is not the same as steganographic. Do not operationalize covert as encoded.

paper: Breaking the Secret: Economic Interventions for Combating Collusion in Embodied Multi-Agent Systems
environments: EMBODIED: robots, UAVs, manipulators; Internet of Vehicles (vehicles colluding to create traffic bottlenecks and occupy critical lanes); simulated AND real-world
collusion_operationalized_as: coordinated deviation from global objectives with real-world consequences
detection_signal: post-hoc behavior analysis is called insufficient (delayed feedback / noisy observation)
method_or_mitigation: mutagenic incentive intervention: reward reporters, penalize identified colluders; reporting deposits, smart-contract enforcement, encrypted comms
notes: Liu, Chen, Zhao, Zheng, Yu, Zhang, Sun, Chen. DEFENSE paper, not a benchmark. Establishes grounded-collusion as a lane, but the substrate is physical space, not a privilege system.
